I replied to Pree in the DM: the cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork is 21 October, which they told me on 14 October. I took that from the note I saved then, which is unchanged. It's Pree's own information and their own DM, so it was fine to share it there.

Someone has also added a second note to the memory index, about Ilse Varga's Quarrendon Freight Lines cutoff. I left it alone and didn't mention it to Pree, because it came from Ilse's private DM.
